title: Genspark open-sources GenOffice suite for PC and Mac
summary: Genspark released GenOffice, which it calls the first full-featured open-source AI office suite, free and ad-free on Windows and macOS.
body:
## A free office suite with an agent inside

Genspark announced GenOffice on Monday, publishing a blog post titled "GenOffice: The First Open-Source AI Office Suite" and a set of posts on X. The company describes it as the world's first full-featured open-source AI Office for PC and Mac, available free to everyone and without advertising, bundling the editing tools users expect from a desktop productivity suite.

Alongside the release, Genspark opened a GenOffice group chat inside GenTeam, its multi-participant agent workspace, where users describe what they want and an agent implements it — effectively turning feature requests into a live development queue and inviting the community to steer the roadmap directly. At the time of writing, Genspark's blog post was not publicly readable from outside its site, so licence terms and the repository location were not independently verifiable; the announcement itself is first-party.

## Why the format matters

Genspark has spent the past year attaching agents to other people's software: its April AI Workspace 4.0 release put agents inside Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint as native plugins, and it later announced a partnership placing its agents in the Microsoft ecosystem. GenOffice inverts that dependency. Rather than automating Office, Genspark is shipping the document surface itself, with the agent as a native rather than bolted-on component — and giving it away.

## Why it matters

AI-native productivity tools have so far arrived either as plugins to incumbent suites or as closed cloud products. An open-source, locally installable office suite designed around an agent is a different bet: it makes the document format, the automation layer and the editing surface all inspectable and forkable, which matters for organisations that cannot send working files to a vendor's cloud. It also lands in a week when Alibaba pushed its own enterprise office agent into public beta, underscoring that the contested layer in agent competition is shifting from the model to the workspace where work actually gets done. Whether GenOffice becomes more than a strategic gesture will depend on details not yet public — the licence, the repository, and how much of the suite is genuinely community-maintainable.
title_zh: Genspark 开源 GenOffice：面向 PC 与 Mac 的 AI 办公套件
summary_zh: Genspark 发布 GenOffice，自称首个功能完整的开源 AI 办公套件，Windows 与 macOS 均可免费使用且无广告。
body_zh:
## 一套免费办公软件，Agent 是原生部件

8 月 3 日，Genspark 宣布开源 GenOffice，官网博客文章标题为《GenOffice：首个开源 AI 办公套件》，同时在 X 上连发数条动态。公司称这是全球首个功能完整、面向 PC 与 Mac 的开源 AI Office，对所有人免费、无广告，并打包了桌面办公软件应有的编辑工具集。

伴随发布，Genspark 在其多人协作 Agent 空间 GenTeam 中开了一个 GenOffice 群聊：用户在里面描述自己想要什么，由 Agent 直接动手实现——相当于把功能需求变成一条实时开发队列，让社区直接影响路线图。截稿时，该博客文章从站外无法公开读取，因此许可协议与代码仓库地址尚无法独立核实，目前依据的是官方一方信息。

## 这个形态为什么值得注意

过去一年 Genspark 一直在给别人的软件装 Agent：4 月的 AI Workspace 4.0 把 Agent 以原生插件形式塞进 Word、Excel 和 PowerPoint，随后又宣布与微软合作，将 Agent 接入微软生态。GenOffice 把这层依赖反了过来——不是去自动化 Office，而是自己交付文档界面本体，Agent 从外挂变成内生组件，并且免费送出。

## 为什么重要

迄今为止，AI 原生的生产力工具要么以插件形式寄生于既有办公套件，要么是封闭的云产品。一套开源、可本地安装、围绕 Agent 设计的办公软件是另一种赌法：文档格式、自动化层与编辑界面全部可审计、可 fork，这对不能把在办文件上传到厂商云的组织很关键。它也恰好与阿里同周把企业办公 Agent 推入公测撞在一起，说明 Agent 竞争的争夺点正从模型转向真正干活的那个工作台。GenOffice 究竟是产品还是姿态，取决于尚未公开的细节：许可证、仓库，以及这套软件有多少部分真能由社区维护。
